kurz: During the first prove, lift the dough a few times and fold it over itself. That strengthens the network without kneading.
bild_im_kopf: Like a towel folded several times: each layer lines up the fibres a little more.
was_passiert: Stretching pulls the [[glutenbildung|gluten strands]] in one direction and lines them up. Folding stacks them in layers. After a few rounds with rests, the dough is smooth and taut and the gas bubbles are preserved.
schritte: Lift the dough on one side and fold it to the middle.
Turn the bowl and repeat all the way round.
3–4 rounds, until the dough is taut.
